Speed drills

One-minute games for the small steps you repeat in every cipher. Build these first, because they're where most of your time goes.

Solving helpers

These apply to every cipher. You can also change them on any question. Tournaments give you none of these, so turn them off to practise for real.

Tools & flashcards

Helpers for practice and for checking your work. Competition rules limit what you can use, so don't rely on them at a tournament.
